title: setup hook outside a git checkout is an environment error (exit 3) that names the folder
source: intended: docs/decisions.md D8 (setup hook, defect N-17): jitso registers its guard in the project's .claude/settings.json without clobbering anything
intent: INTENDED behavior (defect N-17, setup hook). The target is the checkout of the working folder; with none, `jitso: <cwd> is not inside a git checkout`, exit 3, nothing written. The oracle has no `setup` command: it answers `unknown command "setup"` on stderr with exit 2 and prints nothing on stdout, so every expectation that needs this output or file effect FAILS on it.

stderr: is not inside a git checkout
